agent_memory.py:136-152 _get_client records _open_error on any PersistentClient/collection_state failure and leaves _client None, so each later memory call (via _get_collection, line 181, with _collection still None) retries the open; success sets _open_error=None and _client. open_error property (154-164) returns None whenever a client exists. Hostile input considered: a failed open followed by a later turn after the directory becomes writable: the retry in the next turn's enhancer search clears the error, so the answer returns normally with no restart. Residual nuance: a non-NotFound failure in get_collection after a successful client open is not recorded as open_error, but that is not 'store cannot be opened'.
